title: Before you reply
intro: A moment before replying can make a message kinder and clearer. Take what helps.

cards.back: A second read often shows a friendlier meaning than the first.
Try to say it in one sentence. If you cannot, a short question back may be best.
Just one, at your own pace. Then start typing.
Read the message as if it came from someone in a good mood. See whether it sounds different.
Put the main answer first, then any detail underneath.

cards.front: Can it wait a few minutes?
cards.back: If it is not urgent, you can reply after a short break. Come back with fresh eyes.
A short thank you for the question or the effort costs very little.
Look for a word or sentence you can remove without losing meaning.
Names, dates and links. A quick look can save a follow-up.

cards.front: Read it aloud in your head
cards.back: If it sounds like something you would say to a friend, it is probably fine.
